title: ranunculus repens f. glabratus
intro: Ranunculus repens f. glabratus, commonly known as Glabrous Creeping Buttercup, is a subspecies of the Ranunculus repens plant, which is a perennial plant with a creeping habit. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Glabrous Creeping Buttercup include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can help to soothe and protect the skin from infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
